setting: # THIS FILE WINS.  Every row here overrides the matching default built into
# church_year_image.py, so change settings HERE, not in the script's SETTING_SPEC.
# Delete a row (or leave its value blank) to fall back to the script default.
# The web page: what shows under the wheel (full, credit or none) and which
# churches it offers (blank for all; keys, tradition names or lcms-* prefixes).
# The magnification the web page opens at, centered on the day it opens on: 1 (the whole wheel) to 6 (blank: 1). A link's zoom= wins.
# Text on mid-tone colors (either black or white reads): as-set, dark-reds
# (black on the reds only), dark or light.
# Settings the page leaves out, keeping each church's own (calendar, easter
# The Readings boxes checked when the page opens: all (blank), none, the kinds to
# Rings the page opens with turned off (halves,seasons ...), colors it opens with changed
# (PURPLE-7a1f7a,ring.gold-c9a227 ...), and where readings open (biblegateway or youversion; blank: by device).
# The mark after each set of readings that searches Word to Worship for worship songs
# on them: on, off (the box unchecked) or none (no box at all; blank: on).
# How the day's readings are shown when there are several sets: tabs (one set at a
# time) or columns (all of them, the later ones in a column on the left). Both,
# comma-separated, offers the other in Settings, the first opening (blank: tabs,columns).
# The page the web page's Help button opens (blank: no button): the user guide, as the project publishes it.
# The feedback form the page's Feedback link opens (blank: no link). The day's
# link, date and church are added as ?link=&date=&church= (or fill {link}, {date}
# and {church} where the address names them).
# The page's links: all, none, or bible (each reading, and each set together) and
# feasts (each commemoration's page). Without bible there is no Bible or Open in.
# Whether the page offers Download... (the wheel as SVG and PNG, and its lists)
# and Make a page... (a page like itself), under Share: TRUE or FALSE (blank: TRUE).
# Whether the page's arrow keys go on into the next church year at the year's end (TRUE) or round the year on the wheel (FALSE, or blank). Settings has a box for it.
# Whether the page looks for a picture beside it (center.svg, or .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif) to offer in the middle: TRUE or FALSE (blank: FALSE). Off, it asks for no files.
# The Bible versions the page offers: codes (ESV, KJV ...), languages (english
# de, sv ...) or own (each church's own, no menu); one version hides the menu;
# Precedence: where the day outranks a saint's day that falls on it, so the
# day keeps the top of the cell and the feast's color takes the lower half.
# Sundays and named days in these seasons:
